title: SREV-006A SbieIni broker fixed string shape

crt_string_shape.description: CRT string manipulation routines operate on NUL-terminated narrow, wide, or multibyte strings; non-terminated character arrays must be treated as buffers

fixed_field_inventory.description: SbieIni broker fixed WCHAR[66] fields: SBIE_INI_SETTING_REQ.{password,section,setting}; SBIE_INI_TEMPLATE_REQ.{password,varname}; SBIE_INI_PASSWORD_REQ.{old_password,new_password}

terminator_gate.description: Shared SbieIni_HasTerminator helper scans bounded WCHAR arrays for L'\0' before any wcslen/wcscpy/wcscmp/_wcsicmp/_wcsnicmp/wcsrchr/wcsstr/IsCallerAuthorized/INI call

consumption_scope.description: Each fixed field is checked only on the request paths that actually consume it: CheckRequest covers password+section+setting; GetSetting covers section+setting; SetDatFile covers setting; SetTemplate covers varname plus used password; SetOrTestPassword covers used password fields

value_tail_invariant.description: Variable value tails prove the terminator byte is inside the broker message before code reads value[value_len]; CheckSettingValue and CheckTemplateValue enforce value_len bounds plus terminator-in-message

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: malformed broker messages with unterminated fields return invalid-parameter replies without entering INI/password/path logic

contracts: Fixed WCHAR[66] inline strings must contain a L'\0' inside the declared array before C-string API consumption
SbieIni_HasTerminator is the only legal way to certify a fixed inline string before use
CheckSettingStrings calls SbieIni_HasTerminator on password, section, setting

CheckSettingValue and CheckTemplateValue verify FIELD_OFFSET(...,value) <= req->h.length, available bytes >= sizeof(WCHAR), value_len bounded by PIPE_MAX_DATA_LEN/sizeof(WCHAR), value_len*sizeof(WCHAR) <= available - sizeof(WCHAR), req->value[value_len] == 0
Password fields are checked only on the request paths that consume them
